targets.affected_action: Qualifies the venting prohibition in C0000 by exempting the specific substitutes in the specific end-uses listed in (a)(1)(i)-(x). Non-exempt refrigerants and non-listed end-uses remain subject to the prohibition against knowing venting or releases.
targets.rationale: The text in paragraph (a)(1) expressly states that 'the following substitutes in the following end-uses are exempt from this prohibition', directly creating an exception to the venting prohibition defined in C0000.

targets.affected_action: No change is supported. Paragraph (b) obligations to observe applicable practices and use certified equipment remain unaffected.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (b) (C0004) by its own express terms applies only to appliances containing 'a class I or class II refrigerant or a non-exempt substitute refrigerant'. Exempt substitutes are already outside the scope of C0004, and C0001 does not exempt class I or class II refrigerants. Thus, C0001 does not carve out an exception from C0004.

meaning.rationale: The claim text and choice structure accurately represent paragraph (a)(2), which exempts de minimis releases associated with good faith recovery or recycling attempts when either condition (i) or condition (ii) is met.

targets.affected_action: Qualifies the general prohibition against venting or releasing refrigerants in C0000 by exempting de minimis releases associated with good faith attempts to recycle or recover refrigerants where the required practices are followed. All other releases remain prohibited.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (a)(2) states that de minimis releases meeting specified criteria 'are not subject to this prohibition', which directly exempts qualifying de minimis releases from the venting prohibition in (a)(1) (C0000).

targets.affected_action: No change is supported. The rule that knowing release of refrigerant after recovery is a violation remains fully unaffected.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (a)(3) (C0003) makes knowing release of refrigerant after recovery an outright violation. Paragraph (a)(2) applies only to releases associated with good faith attempts to recycle or recover, not intentional venting of refrigerant after recovery. Treating C0002 as qualifying C0003 would wrongly allow intentional release of recovered refrigerant under the guise of de minimis.

targets.affected_action: No change is supported. The prohibition against maintaining, servicing, repairing, or disposing of appliances without observing required practices and using certified equipment remains intact.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (a)(2) exempts de minimis releases solely from 'this prohibition' (the venting prohibition under paragraph (a)), not from the separate maintenance and servicing requirements of paragraph (b) (C0004). Observing those very practices is an explicit prerequisite to qualify for the de minimis release exemption under (a)(2)(i).
